records.literal_gloss: For the director, al-tashheth. A psalm of Asaph, a song.

en.L: For the director: "Do not destroy." A psalm of Asaph, a song.
en.B: For the music director. To the tune "Do Not Destroy." A psalm of Asaph. A song.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To the tune "Do Not Destroy." A song of Asaph.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : « Ne détruis pas ». Psaume d’Asaph, cantique.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Sur l’air « Ne détruis pas ». Psaume d’Asaph. Cantique.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Sur l’air « Ne détruis pas ». Chant d’Asaph.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: "Usiharibu." Zaburi ya Asafu, wimbo.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa sauti ya "Usiharibu." Zaburi ya Asafu. Wimbo.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kwa sauti ya "Usiharibu." Wimbo wa Asafu.

es.L: Al director del coro: «No destruyas». Salmo de Asaf, cántico.
es.B: Al director del coro. Con la melodía «No destruyas». Salmo de Asaf. Cántico.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Con la melodía «No destruyas». Canto de Asaf.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: "Đừng hủy diệt." [Một] thi thiên của A-sáp, [một] bài ca.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Theo điệu "Đừng Hủy Diệt". Thi thiên của A-sáp. Bài ca.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Theo điệu "Đừng Hủy Diệt". Bài ca của A-sáp.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. "멸하지 마라". 아삽의 시, 노래.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. "멸하지 마라" 곡조에 맞추어. 아삽의 시. 노래.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해. "멸하지 마라" 곡조에 맞추어. 아삽이 지은 노래.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: al-tashheth: "do not destroy", probably a tune
alternatives: a note about how the scroll was to be kept
decisions.reason: The words ('al tashchet) mean "do not destroy". They stand in the titles of Psalms 57-59 and 75, and probably name a tune the psalm was sung to. Moses prays with the same words in Deuteronomy 9:26. Their exact sense in a title is no longer known.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work (1 Chronicles 25:1-2). Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name.

decisions.choice: "Do not destroy" (L); To the tune "Do Not Destroy" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words have a plain meaning, so every level translates them, as in Psalms 57-59; Balanced and Readable add their likeliest use, a tune (m3).

decisions.choice: A song of Asaph
alternatives: A psalm of Asaph, a song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1, Readable says "song" for psalm and drops the doubled term.

decisions.choice: shir is "cantique" (Literal, Balanced); Readable folds psalm and song into one "Chant", as the English Readable does
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "cantique" for shir at Literal and Balanced and "chant" at Readable, where mizmor is also "chant"; Readable says it once.

decisions.choice: "Usiharibu" (Do not destroy) for al-tashchet; "Kwa sauti ya" (to the tune of) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The English translates the words and takes them as the name of a tune at Balanced and Readable; Swahili does the same. "Kwa sauti ya" is the ordinary Swahili way to name the tune a song is sung to.

decisions.choice: «No destruyas» (L); Con la melodía «No destruyas» (B, R); cántico (L, B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew al-tashheth means "do not destroy" and is probably the name of a tune. Spanish translates it, as the English does, and Balanced and Readable say it is a tune, which is likely but not certain. Shir, "song", is "cántico" at Literal and Balanced; Readable folds it into "Canto de Asaf", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Đừng hủy diệt" (L); "Theo điệu \"Đừng Hủy Diệt\"" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words mean "do not destroy" and probably name a tune (see the meaning decision). As the English does, every level translates them, and Balanced and Readable say it is a tune; "thi thiên" and "bài ca" stand for the two Hebrew words for the song.

decisions.choice: "\"멸하지 마라\"" (L), "\"멸하지 마라\" 곡조에 맞추어" (B, R) for al-tashheth
alternatives: "알다스헷", the Hebrew kept as a name
decisions.reason: The English translates the words at every level and reads them as probably the name of a tune (meaning decision); Korean does the same. The tune is uncertain.

source.text: ה֘וֹדִ֤ינוּ לְּךָ֨׀אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ וְקָר֣וֹב שְׁמֶ֑ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: We give thanks to you, God, we give thanks, and near [is] your name; they recount your wonders.

en.L: We give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, God, we give thanks, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name [is] near; \q they recount {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders.
en.B: We thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, God, we thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name is close to us, \q and people speak of the marvels {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.
en.R: We thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, God! We thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are close to us. \q People talk about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.

fr.L: Nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendons grâce, ô Dieu, nous rendons grâce, et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom [est] proche ; \q on raconte {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles.
fr.B: Nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendons grâce, ô Dieu, nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendons grâce ; {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est près de nous, \q et l’on raconte les merveilles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.
fr.R: Nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercions, Dieu ! Nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercions, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es près de nous. \q Les gens parlent des choses étonnantes que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites.

sw.L: Tunakushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Mungu, tunakushukuru, na jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} [li] karibu; \q [watu] husimulia maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Tunakushukuru, Ee Mungu, tunakushukuru; jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} liko karibu nasi, \q na watu husimulia maajabu uliyoyatenda {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.R: Tunakushukuru, Mungu! Tunakushukuru, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uko karibu nasi. \q Watu huzungumza juu ya mambo ya ajabu uliyoyatenda.

es.L: Te damos gracias, oh Dios, damos gracias, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre [está] cerca; \q cuentan {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas.
es.B: Te damos gracias, oh Dios, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} damos gracias; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre está cerca de nosotros, \q y la gente habla de las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.
es.R: ¡Te damos gracias, Dios! Te damos gracias, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estás cerca de nosotros. \q La gente habla de las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho.

vi.L: Chúng tôi cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, chúng tôi cảm tạ, và danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thì] gần; \q người ta thuật lại những việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, chúng tôi cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng tôi cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở gần chúng tôi, \q và người ta kể lại những việc lạ lùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, chúng tôi cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Chúng tôi cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở gần chúng tôi. \q Người ta nói về những việc tuyệt diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 저희가 주님께 감사합니다, 하나님, 저희가 감사합니다. 주님의 이름이 가까이 [있습니다]. \q 사람들이 주님의 기이한 일들을 이야기합니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 저희가 주님께 감사합니다. 감사합니다. 주님의 이름이 저희 가까이 있으니, \q 사람들이 주님께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 이야기합니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 감사합니다! 주님께서 저희 가까이 계시니 감사합니다. \q 사람들이 주님께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 이야기합니다.

decisions.choice: your name is near: you yourself are near and active
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself as he makes himself known (20:2; 54:3). That his name is near means he is present to help, and the wonders people tell are the proof.

decisions.choice: and near is your name
alternatives: and we will call on your name (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "and we will call on your name", from a slightly different reading of the same letters. The words follow the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: they recount: people tell
decisions.reason: The verb is plural with no subject named: people in general tell of God's wonders. Some ancient translations read "we will tell".

decisions.choice: you are close to us
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: The people thank God in 합쇼체 as "저희" (verse 2); God speaks in 해라체 with "나" (verses 3-6); verses 7-11 speak of God in the plain written style
alternatives: one speech level for the whole psalm
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a and the terms note (God speaking uses 해라체 with 나). The speakers change in this psalm as the English quotation marks show.

source.text: כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: For I will take [the] appointed time; I — uprightness I will judge.

en.L: "When I take the appointed time, \q I — I will judge [with] uprightness.
en.B: "When the time I have fixed has come, \q I will judge with fairness.
en.R: "I will pick the right time, \q and I will judge fairly.

fr.L: « Quand je saisirai le moment fixé, \q moi, je jugerai [avec] droiture.
fr.B: « Quand viendra le moment que j’ai fixé, \q je jugerai avec équité.
fr.R: « Je choisirai le bon moment, \q et je jugerai avec justice.

sw.L: "Nitakapoutwaa wakati ulioamriwa, \q mimi, mimi nitahukumu [kwa] unyofu.
sw.R: "Nitachagua wakati unaofaa, \q nami nitahukumu kwa haki.

es.L: «Cuando yo tome el tiempo señalado, \q yo, yo juzgaré [con] rectitud.
es.B: «Cuando llegue el tiempo que he fijado, \q juzgaré con justicia.
es.R: «Yo escogeré el momento oportuno, \q y juzgaré con justicia.

vi.L: "Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chọn thời điểm đã định, \q chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xét xử [cách] ngay thẳng.
vi.B: "Khi đến thời điểm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã định, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xét xử cách công minh.
vi.R: "Ta sẽ chọn đúng thời điểm, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xét xử cách công bằng.

ko.L: "내가 정한 때를 잡을 때에, \q 나, 내가 공평하게 심판하겠다.
ko.B: "내가 정한 때가 이르면, \q 내가 공정하게 심판하겠다.

decisions.choice: God speaks in verses 3-6
alternatives: God speaks in verses 3-4 only, and the psalmist answers the proud in 5-6
decisions.reason: Without a speech formula the voice changes from "we" (verse 2) to an "I" who sets the time of judgment and holds up the earth (verse 4). Only God does that, so his words are put in quotation marks, as in 46:11 and 50:5, until the warning to the proud ends at verse 6.

decisions.choice: appointed time: the time God has set
decisions.reason: The word (mo'ed) is a fixed time or meeting. God chooses the moment when he will act as judge (102:14; Habakkuk 2:3).

decisions.choice: uprightness: what is level and fair
decisions.reason: The word (mesharim) means what is straight or level, and so fairness in judging (9:9; 58:2).

decisions.choice: God speaks in the first person singular, "je", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: In verses 3-6 God himself speaks (meaning decision m1). French gives him the plain "je", as the terms note sets for God speaking; "je" never carries the setting.

decisions.choice: God speaks with "mimi" in verses 3-6, written out at Literal ("mimi, mimi") for the doubled Hebrew "I"
alternatives: "Mimi" with a capital as a deity pronoun
decisions.reason: The terms note has God speak as "mimi". The deity_pronoun setting is not used here because the English has no span on God's "I".

decisions.choice: God speaks of himself as "Ta"
decisions.reason: In verses 3-6 God himself speaks (see the meaning decision). As the style guide sets it, God speaking says "Ta", with the deity_pronoun setting in the middle of a sentence, and speaks to the proud as "các người", the plain form for a rebuke.

source.text: נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ סֶּֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Melting [are the] earth and all its inhabitants; I — I set firm its pillars. Selah.

en.L: [When] the earth and all its inhabitants melt, \q I — I set firm its pillars. Selah
en.B: The earth and everyone on it may sway and melt, \q but I have set its pillars firm. Selah
en.R: The earth and all its people may shake and fall apart, \q but I am the one who keeps its foundations standing. Selah

fr.L: [Quand] la terre et tous ses habitants fondent, \q moi, j’affermis ses colonnes. Sélah
fr.B: La terre et tous ceux qui l’habitent peuvent vaciller et fondre, \q mais moi, j’ai affermi ses colonnes. Sélah
fr.R: La terre et tous ses habitants peuvent trembler et s’effondrer, \q mais c’est moi qui garde ses fondations debout. Sélah

sw.L: [Wakati] dunia na wakaao wote ndani yake wanayeyuka, \q mimi, mimi nimeziimarisha nguzo zake. Sela
sw.B: Dunia na wote waliomo wanaweza kuyumba na kuyeyuka, \q lakini mimi nimeziweka nguzo zake imara. Sela
sw.R: Dunia na watu wake wote wanaweza kutetemeka na kusambaratika, \q lakini mimi ndiye ninayeishikilia misingi yake isimame. Sela

es.L: [Cuando] se derritan la tierra y todos sus habitantes, \q yo, yo afirmo sus columnas. Selah
es.B: Puede que la tierra y todos los que la habitan se tambaleen y se derritan, \q pero yo he afirmado sus columnas. Selah
es.R: La tierra y toda su gente pueden temblar y deshacerse, \q pero yo soy el que mantiene firmes sus cimientos. Selah

vi.L: [Khi] đất và mọi cư dân trên đất tan chảy, \q chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm vững chắc các cột trụ của nó. Sê-la
vi.B: Dù đất và mọi người trên đất có lung lay tan chảy, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho các cột trụ của nó vững chắc. Sê-la
vi.R: Đất và mọi người trên đất có thể rung chuyển và tan rã, \q nhưng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đấng giữ cho nền móng của nó đứng vững. Sê-la

ko.L: 땅과 그 모든 주민이 녹아내릴 [때], \q 나, 내가 그 기둥들을 굳게 세운다. 셀라
ko.B: 땅과 그 위의 모든 사람이 흔들리고 녹아내려도, \q 내가 그 기둥들을 굳게 세워 두었다. 셀라
ko.R: 땅과 그 위의 모든 사람이 흔들리고 무너질지라도, \q 땅의 기초를 버티게 하는 이는 바로 나다. 셀라

decisions.choice: melting: losing all firmness
decisions.reason: The verb (mug) is used of things that dissolve or of people who lose heart in fear (Exodus 15:15; 46:7). Here the whole world seems to give way.

decisions.choice: its pillars: what holds the world up
decisions.reason: The earth was pictured as resting on pillars (1 Samuel 2:8; Job 9:6). However much the world shakes, God holds it steady, so his judgment is sure.

decisions.choice: its foundations
decisions.reason: Readable uses the more familiar picture for what holds the earth up.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sélah" kept at the end of the verse at every level, for this block
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown, probably a direction for the music (meaning decision m3), so French keeps the word, in its usual French spelling, as the English keeps "Selah".

decisions.choice: "Sela" for Selah, kept at the end of the verse at every level, through Psalms 69-83
decisions.reason: The meaning of the word is no longer known; it is probably a musical direction. The terms note keeps it in its Swahili spelling, untranslated, as the English keeps "Selah".

decisions.choice: Selah
decisions.reason: Selah is a Hebrew word whose meaning is no longer known; it is probably a direction for the music or the singers. Spanish keeps it as it is, at the end of the verse, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la", kept as it is at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: Selah is a word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction (see the meaning decision). Like the English, every level keeps it as a word, in the Protestant tradition's spelling, and does not guess at a translation.

decisions.choice: "셀라" at the end of the verse, at every level
decisions.reason: A word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a direction for the music (meaning decision); it is kept as it is, at the end of its verse, as the terms note says. This holds for every Selah in Psalms 69-83.

source.text: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַֽ֭הוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝לָרְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל־תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: I say to the boasting: Do not boast; and to the wicked: Do not lift up a horn.

en.L: I say to the boastful, 'Do not boast,' \q and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up [the] horn.'
en.B: I tell the proud, 'Stop your boasting,' \q and the wicked, 'Do not toss your horn high.'
en.R: I tell people who brag, 'Stop bragging!' \q I tell the wicked, 'Stop showing off your strength.'

fr.L: Je dis aux orgueilleux : “Ne vous vantez pas”, \q et aux méchants : “Ne levez pas [la] corne.”
fr.B: Je dis aux arrogants : “Cessez de vous vanter”, \q et aux méchants : “Ne dressez pas si haut la corne.”
fr.R: Je dis à ceux qui se vantent : “Arrêtez de vous vanter !” \q Je dis aux méchants : “Arrêtez de montrer votre force.”

sw.L: Nawaambia wenye kujivuna, 'Msijivune,' \q na waovu, 'Msiinue pembe.'
sw.B: Nawaambia wenye kiburi, 'Acheni kujisifu,' \q na waovu, 'Msiinue pembe zenu juu.'
sw.R: Nawaambia watu wanaojigamba, 'Acheni kujigamba!' \q Nawaambia waovu, 'Acheni kujionyesha kwa nguvu zenu.'

es.L: Digo a los arrogantes: “No {{plural_you:se jacten|os jactéis}}”, \q y a los malvados: “No {{plural_you:levanten|levantéis}} [el] cuerno”.
es.B: Digo a los orgullosos: “{{plural_you:Dejen de jactarse|Dejad de jactaros}}”, \q y a los malvados: “No {{plural_you:alcen|alcéis}} tan alto el cuerno”.
es.R: Digo a los que presumen: “¡{{plural_you:Dejen de presumir|Dejad de presumir}}!”. \q Digo a los malvados: “{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de hacer alarde de {{plural_you:su fuerza|vuestra fuerza}}”.

vi.L: Ta nói với những kẻ khoe khoang: 'Đừng khoe khoang,' \q và với những kẻ ác: 'Đừng ngước sừng lên.'
vi.B: Ta bảo những kẻ kiêu căng: 'Hãy thôi khoe khoang,' \q và bảo những kẻ ác: 'Đừng hất sừng lên cao.'
vi.R: Ta bảo những kẻ khoác lác: 'Đừng khoác lác nữa!' \q Ta bảo những kẻ ác: 'Đừng khoe sức mạnh của các người nữa.'

ko.L: 내가 자랑하는 자들에게 '자랑하지 마라' 하고, \q 악인들에게 '뿔을 들지 마라' 한다.
ko.B: 나는 교만한 자들에게 '뽐내지 마라' 하고, \q 악인들에게 '뿔을 높이 쳐들지 마라' 하고 말한다.
ko.R: 나는 자랑하는 사람들에게 '그만 자랑하여라!' 하고 말한다. \q 악한 사람들에게 '힘자랑을 그만두어라' 하고 말한다.

decisions.choice: lift up a horn: show off one's strength
decisions.reason: A horn is a picture of strength and pride, like a wild ox tossing its head (Deuteronomy 33:17; 1 Samuel 2:1). To lift up the horn is to flaunt power. The picture returns in verses 6 and 11.

decisions.choice: the boastful: people who brag
decisions.reason: The verb (halal) here means to boast, or to act like a fool (5:6; 73:3).

decisions.choice: showing off your strength
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: אַל־תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not lift up on high your horn; [do not] speak with an arrogant neck.

en.L: Do not lift up your horn on high; \q [do not] speak with an arrogant neck."
en.B: Do not raise your horn against the heights, \q or talk with a stiff and insolent neck."
en.R: Do not act as if you were above everyone. \q Do not talk back with such pride."

fr.L: Ne levez pas votre corne en haut ; \q [ne] parlez [pas] avec un cou arrogant. »
fr.B: Ne dressez pas votre corne contre les hauteurs, \q ne parlez pas avec un cou raide et insolent. »
fr.R: Ne faites pas comme si vous étiez au-dessus de tout le monde. \q Ne répondez pas avec tant d’orgueil. »

sw.L: Msiinue pembe yenu juu; \q msinene kwa shingo ya kiburi."
sw.B: Msiinue pembe yenu dhidi ya walio juu, \q wala msiseme kwa shingo ngumu ya ufidhuli."
sw.R: Msijifanye kana kwamba mko juu ya kila mtu. \q Msijibu kwa kiburi hivyo."

es.L: No {{plural_you:levanten|levantéis}} en alto {{plural_you:su cuerno|vuestro cuerno}}; \q [no] {{plural_you:hablen|habléis}} con cuello arrogante».
es.B: No {{plural_you:alcen|alcéis}} {{plural_you:su cuerno|vuestro cuerno}} contra las alturas, \q ni {{plural_you:hablen|habléis}} con el cuello rígido e insolente».
es.R: No {{plural_you:actúen|actuéis}} como si {{plural_you:estuvieran|estuvierais}} por encima de todos. \q No {{plural_you:contesten|contestéis}} con tanto orgullo».

vi.L: Đừng ngước sừng các người lên cao; \q [đừng] nói với cổ kiêu ngạo."
vi.B: Đừng ngước sừng các người lên chống nghịch trời cao, \q hay nói năng với cổ cứng cỏi xấc xược."
vi.R: Đừng làm như các người ở trên mọi người. \q Đừng cãi lại với giọng kiêu ngạo như thế."

ko.L: 너희 뿔을 높이 들지 마라. \q 오만한 목으로 말하지 마라."
ko.B: 너희 뿔을 높은 곳을 향해 쳐들지 마라. \q 뻣뻣하고 거만한 목으로 말하지 마라."
ko.R: 모든 사람 위에 있는 것처럼 굴지 마라. \q 그렇게 교만하게 대들지 마라."

decisions.choice: an arrogant neck: a proud, stubborn bearing
decisions.reason: A stiff or outstretched neck is a picture of pride and defiance (Isaiah 3:16; Job 15:26). The proud speak with head held high.

decisions.choice: on high: upward, in defiance
decisions.reason: The word (marom) means the height; it can also stand for heaven or for God himself (56:3; 92:9), so the line may mean raising the horn against God.

decisions.choice: with an arrogant neck
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "against God", taking the word for "neck" (tsavva'r) as "rock" (tsur), a title of God. The words follow the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: act as if you were above everyone; talk back with such pride
alternatives: lift up your horn on high
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pictures mean (m1).

source.text: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭מּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For not from [the] going out and from [the] setting place, and not from [the] wilderness [is] lifting up.

en.L: For not from the east or from the west, \q and not from the wilderness [comes] lifting up,
en.B: For it is not from the east or the west, \q nor from the desert, that a person is raised up,
en.R: No one gets to the top with help from the east or the west \q or the desert.

fr.L: Car ce n’est ni de l’orient ni de l’occident, \q ni du désert [que vient] l’élévation,
fr.B: Car ce n’est ni de l’orient ni de l’occident, \q ni du désert que vient l’élévation,
fr.R: Personne n’arrive en haut grâce à l’aide de l’est ou de l’ouest, \q ou du désert.

sw.L: Kwa maana si kutoka mashariki wala kutoka magharibi, \q wala si kutoka jangwani [kuja] kuinuliwa,
sw.B: Kwa maana si kutoka mashariki wala magharibi, \q wala si kutoka jangwani, mtu anapoinuliwa,
sw.R: Hakuna mtu anayefika juu kwa msaada wa mashariki au wa magharibi \q au wa jangwa.

es.L: Porque ni del oriente ni del occidente, \q ni del desierto [viene] el enaltecimiento,
es.B: Porque no es del oriente ni del occidente, \q ni del desierto, de donde alguien es levantado,
es.R: Nadie llega a lo más alto con ayuda del oriente o del occidente \q o del desierto.

vi.L: Vì chẳng phải từ phương đông hay từ phương tây, \q và chẳng phải từ hoang mạc [mà] sự nâng lên [đến],
vi.B: Vì chẳng phải từ phương đông hay phương tây, \q cũng chẳng phải từ sa mạc, mà một người được nâng lên,
vi.R: Không ai lên đến chỗ cao nhờ sự giúp đỡ từ phương đông hay phương tây \q hay từ sa mạc.

ko.L: 참으로 동쪽에서도 서쪽에서도 아니고, \q 광야에서도 아니다, 높이는 것은.
ko.B: 사람을 높이는 것은 동쪽에서도 서쪽에서도 오지 않고, \q 광야에서도 오지 않는다.
ko.R: 사람이 높은 자리에 오르는 것은 동쪽이나 서쪽에서 오는 도움 때문이 아니다. \q 광야에서 오는 도움 때문도 아니다.

decisions.choice: east, west and wilderness: every direction
decisions.reason: The "going out" (of the sun) is the east and its "setting place" the west. The wilderness lies to the south of Judah, and north is not named. However far anyone looks, help to rise does not come from there, but from God (verse 8).

decisions.choice: lifting up: being raised to honor
alternatives: from the wilderness of the mountains
decisions.reason: The last word (harim) is read as "lifting up", the verb of verses 5-6 and 8. The same letters can also be read "mountains", giving "nor from the wilderness of mountains" and leaving the sentence unfinished.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The sentence continues into verse 8 ("but God is the judge"), so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: gets to the top
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what being "lifted up" means.

source.text: כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: But God [is the] judge; this [one] he brings low and this [one] he lifts up.

en.L: but God [is the] judge; \q this [one] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings low, and this [one] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lifts up.
en.B: but God is the judge: \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lays one person low and lifts another up.
en.R: God is the judge. \q He decides who goes down and who goes up.

fr.L: mais Dieu [est] juge ; \q celui-ci, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’abaisse, et celui-là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’élève.
fr.B: mais c’est Dieu qui juge : \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} abaisse l’un et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} élève l’autre.
fr.R: C’est Dieu qui est le juge. \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui décide qui descend et qui monte.

sw.L: bali Mungu [ndiye] mwamuzi; \q huyu humshusha, na huyu humwinua.
sw.B: bali Mungu ndiye mwamuzi: \q humshusha mmoja na kumwinua mwingine.
sw.R: Mungu ndiye mwamuzi. \q Yeye ndiye anayeamua nani ashuke na nani apande.

es.L: sino que Dios [es el] juez; \q a este {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} humilla, y a este {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} enaltece.
es.B: sino que Dios es el juez: \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} abate a uno y levanta a otro.
es.R: Dios es el juez. \q Él decide quién baja y quién sube.

vi.L: nhưng Đức Chúa Trời [là] thẩm phán; \q người này {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hạ xuống, và người kia {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nâng lên.
vi.B: nhưng Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng xét xử: \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hạ người này xuống và nâng người kia lên.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng xét xử. \q Ngài quyết định ai bị hạ xuống và ai được nâng lên.

ko.L: 오직 하나님께서 재판관[이시다]. \q 이 사람은 낮추시고, 저 사람은 높이신다.
ko.B: 오직 하나님께서 재판관이시니, \q 어떤 사람은 낮추시고 어떤 사람은 높이신다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 재판관이시다. \q 누가 낮아지고 누가 높아질지 그분께서 정하신다.

decisions.choice: he brings low and lifts up: as in Hannah's song
decisions.reason: Hannah sings the same truth: the LORD makes poor and makes rich, brings low and lifts up (1 Samuel 2:7). Rank comes from God, not from any place on earth.

decisions.choice: judge: the one who rules and decides
decisions.reason: The word (shofet) is one who judges and governs. As in verse 3, God decides who rises and who falls.

source.text: כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד־יְהוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר׀מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: For a cup [is] in [the] hand of YHWH, and [the] wine foams, full of mixture, and he pours out from this; surely its dregs they will drain, they will drink, all [the] wicked of [the] earth.

en.L: For a cup [is] in the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the wine foams, full of mixture, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pours out from it; \q surely its dregs they will drain [and] drink, \q all the wicked of the earth.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} holds a cup in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand, and the wine in it foams, richly spiced; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pours from it, \q and every wicked person on earth will have to drain it, dregs and all.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is holding a cup of strong, foaming wine mixed with spices. That cup is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger. He pours it out, \q and all the wicked people on earth will have to drink every last drop.

fr.L: Car une coupe [est] dans la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et le vin écume, plein de mélange, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en verse ; \q oui, sa lie, ils la videront [et] la boiront, \q tous les méchants de la terre.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tient une coupe dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main, et le vin y écume, richement épicé ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en verse, \q et tous les méchants de la terre devront la vider, jusqu’à la lie.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tient une coupe de vin fort et écumant, mêlé d’épices. Cette coupe, c’est {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère. Il la verse, \q et tous les méchants de la terre devront en boire jusqu’à la dernière goutte.

sw.L: Kwa maana kikombe [kiko] mkononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na divai inatoa povu, imejaa machanganyiko, naye humimina kutoka humo; \q hakika sira zake watazifyonza [na] kuzinywa, \q waovu wote wa dunia.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameshika kikombe mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, na divai ndani yake inatoa povu, imekolezwa viungo; huimimina kutoka humo, \q na kila mtu mwovu duniani atalazimika kuinywa yote, hata sira zake.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameshika kikombe cha divai kali yenye povu iliyochanganywa na viungo. Kikombe hicho ni hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Anaimimina, \q na watu waovu wote duniani watalazimika kunywa mpaka tone la mwisho.

es.L: Porque una copa [está] en la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y el vino espumea, lleno de mezcla, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} derrama de ella; \q ciertamente sus heces apurarán [y] beberán \q todos los malvados de la tierra.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene una copa en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano, y el vino que hay en ella espumea, bien sazonado; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sirve de ella, \q y todos los malvados de la tierra tendrán que vaciarla hasta el fondo, con sus heces.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene en la mano una copa de vino fuerte y espumoso, mezclado con especias. Esa copa es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira. Él la derrama, \q y todos los malvados de la tierra tendrán que beberla hasta la última gota.

vi.L: Vì một cái chén [ở] trong tay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và rượu sủi bọt, đầy [rượu] pha, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rót ra từ đó; \q chắc chắn cặn của nó chúng sẽ hút cạn [và] uống, \q tất cả những kẻ ác trên đất.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cầm trong tay một cái chén, rượu trong chén sủi bọt, pha nhiều hương liệu; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rót ra từ chén ấy, \q và mọi kẻ ác trên đất sẽ phải uống cạn, đến tận cặn.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang cầm một chén rượu mạnh sủi bọt pha với hương liệu. Chén ấy là cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài rót nó ra, \q và mọi kẻ ác trên đất sẽ phải uống đến giọt cuối cùng.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 손에 잔이 [있고], 포도주가 거품을 내며 섞은 것으로 가득한데, 그분께서 그것을 따르시니, \q 참으로 그 찌꺼기까지 그들이 들이켜 마실 것이다, \q 땅의 모든 악인이.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 손에 잔을 들고 계시는데, 그 포도주는 향료를 듬뿍 섞어 거품이 인다. 그분께서 그것을 따르시니, \q 땅의 모든 악인이 그 찌꺼기까지 다 마셔야 할 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 향료를 섞어 거품이 이는 독한 포도주 잔을 들고 계신다. 그 잔은 그분의 진노이다. 그분께서 그것을 따르시니, \q 땅의 모든 악한 사람이 마지막 한 방울까지 다 마셔야 할 것이다.

decisions.choice: a cup in the LORD's hand: his judgment
decisions.reason: The cup of wine God makes the nations drink is a picture of his anger and judgment (11:6; Jeremiah 25:15-16; Isaiah 51:17). It is the strong drink that makes them stagger and fall.

decisions.choice: mixture: spiced wine
decisions.reason: The word (mesekh) is a mixed drink, wine made stronger with spices (Proverbs 23:30).

decisions.choice: dregs: the bitter sediment at the bottom
decisions.reason: To drink to the dregs is to drink all of it; nothing of the judgment is held back.

decisions.choice: That cup is his anger.
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m1).

source.text: וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And I — I will declare forever; I will sing praise to [the] God of Jacob.

en.L: But I — I will declare [it] forever; \q I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
en.B: But I will never stop telling of it; \q I will make music to the God of Jacob.
en.R: But I will always tell what God has done. \q I will sing songs of praise to the God of Jacob.

fr.L: Mais moi, je [le] proclamerai pour toujours ; \q je chanterai la louange du Dieu de Jacob.
fr.B: Mais moi, je ne cesserai pas de le raconter ; \q je jouerai pour le Dieu de Jacob.
fr.R: Mais moi, je dirai toujours ce que Dieu a fait. \q Je chanterai des chants de louange pour le Dieu de Jacob.

sw.L: Lakini mimi, nitatangaza [jambo hilo] milele; \q nitamwimbia sifa Mungu wa Yakobo.
sw.B: Lakini mimi sitaacha kamwe kulisimulia; \q nitampigia Mungu wa Yakobo muziki.
sw.R: Lakini mimi nitasimulia daima aliyoyatenda Mungu. \q Nitamwimbia Mungu wa Yakobo nyimbo za sifa.

es.L: Pero yo, yo [lo] anunciaré para siempre; \q cantaré alabanzas al Dios de Jacob.
es.B: Pero yo nunca dejaré de contarlo; \q cantaré y tocaré para el Dios de Jacob.
es.R: Pero yo siempre contaré lo que Dios ha hecho. \q Cantaré canciones de alabanza al Dios de Jacob.

vi.L: Nhưng tôi, tôi sẽ rao truyền [điều đó] mãi mãi; \q tôi sẽ hát ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.
vi.B: Nhưng tôi sẽ không ngừng thuật lại điều ấy; \q tôi sẽ đàn hát dâng lên Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.
vi.R: Nhưng tôi sẽ luôn kể lại những gì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm. \q Tôi sẽ hát những bài ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp.

ko.L: 그러나 나는, 내가 영원히 [그것을] 알리고, \q 야곱의 하나님께 찬양을 노래할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 그 일을 쉬지 않고 전하며, \q 야곱의 하나님께 노래할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 하나님께서 하신 일을 언제나 이야기할 것이다. \q 야곱의 하나님께 찬양의 노래를 부를 것이다.

decisions.choice: I will declare
alternatives: I will rejoice (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "I will rejoice", which differs from "I will declare" by one letter. The words follow the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: declare: tell what God has done
decisions.reason: The verb has no object; what the psalmist will tell is God's judgment just described (verses 8-9), the wonders of verse 2.

decisions.choice: it (B); what God has done (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the object the Hebrew leaves unsaid (m2).

source.text: וְכָל־קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ תְּ֝רוֹמַ֗מְנָה קַֽרְנ֥וֹת צַדִּֽיק׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] horns of [the] wicked I will cut off; lifted up will be [the] horns of [the] righteous.

en.L: And all the horns of the wicked I will cut off; \q the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.
en.B: I will hack off every horn the wicked raise, \q but those who do right will have their horns lifted high.
en.R: I will break the power of the wicked, \q but people who do what is right will be made strong.

fr.L: Et toutes les cornes des méchants, je les abattrai ; \q les cornes du juste seront élevées.
fr.B: J’abattrai toutes les cornes que dressent les méchants, \q mais ceux qui font le bien verront leur corne élevée.
fr.R: Je briserai le pouvoir des méchants, \q mais ceux qui font ce qui est juste deviendront forts.

sw.L: Na pembe zote za waovu nitazikata; \q pembe za mwenye haki zitainuliwa.
sw.B: Nitazikatakata pembe zote wanazoziinua waovu, \q lakini wale watendao haki watainuliwa pembe zao juu.
sw.R: Nitavunja nguvu za waovu, \q lakini watu watendao haki watafanywa kuwa na nguvu.

es.L: Y todos los cuernos de los malvados cortaré; \q los cuernos de los justos serán levantados.
es.B: Cortaré todo cuerno que alcen los malvados, \q pero los que hacen el bien tendrán sus cuernos bien en alto.
es.R: Quebraré el poder de los malvados, \q pero los que hacen lo correcto serán fortalecidos.

vi.L: Và mọi sừng của những kẻ ác tôi sẽ chặt đi; \q sừng của những người công chính sẽ được nâng lên.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ chặt bỏ mọi chiếc sừng kẻ ác ngước lên, \q nhưng những người làm điều ngay thẳng sẽ được nâng sừng lên cao.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ bẻ gãy quyền lực của kẻ ác, \q nhưng những người làm điều đúng sẽ được làm cho mạnh mẽ.

ko.L: 그리고 악인들의 모든 뿔을 내가 잘라 내고, \q 의인의 뿔들은 높이 들릴 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 악인들이 쳐드는 뿔을 모두 잘라 버릴 것이나, \q 바르게 사는 사람의 뿔은 높이 들릴 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 악한 사람들의 힘을 꺾을 것이다. \q 그러나 옳은 일을 하는 사람들은 강해질 것이다.

decisions.choice: I will cut off: the psalmist, as God's servant
alternatives: God speaks again, as in verses 3-6
decisions.reason: The "I" carries on from verse 10, so it is read as the psalmist (perhaps speaking for the king) vowing to do God's work. Because only God brings low and lifts up (verse 8), the line may instead be God's own words again.

decisions.choice: horns: strength and pride
decisions.reason: As in verses 5-6, the horn stands for strength. The proud horns are cut off; the horns of the righteous are raised (89:18; 92:11).

decisions.choice: break the power; be made strong
alternatives: the horns will be lifted up
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).
